This week: 34 mi over 5 runs.
Body: "Legs heavy and flat. Nothing hurts, they just feel dead."
Feeling: "Nervous. I feel like I'm losing fitness."
Asks: "Is it crazy to do one more 16-miler on Wednesday so I feel ready?"

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Marisol: Keep volume light, finish the race feeling fresh and confident.
Answers: No, adding a 16-mile run on Wednesday would be too much for a taper week and could interfere with recovery. Stick to the planned quality run.
Next week:
Mon: rest, full recovery before race week.
Tue: easy, 4 mi, heart rate under 150, smooth run to keep legs loose.
Wed: quality, 4 mi, 4×800 m at marathon pace with 400 m recoveries, keep legs sharp.
Thu: easy, 3 mi, relaxed pace to preserve energy.
Fri: rest, total rest before the race.
Sat: long, 8 mi, easy pace, keep heart rate under 155, gentle strides.
Sun: race day.
